summary.rotor_mass_source: rotor iron + magnets + shaft + sleeve, measured on the CAD polygons
summary.model: SKF frictional-moment model (tables 2 and 3) + analytic windage — ANALYTIC, not FEM
notes: Unbalanced magnetic pull is NOT modelled: an off-centre rotor is pulled toward the short side by a force that can exceed its own weight, and it would go straight into F_r. Nor are coupling, belt or gear side loads, or any seal on the shaft itself.
radial load = rotor weight, half each (no bearing span given)
